opening_paragraph: I am excited to apply for the Senior Customer Success Manager role at [Company]. For the past several years I have owned enterprise renewals and adoption at Brightspan Software, and the way Plumline Software measures this role on gross and net revenue retention is exactly how I measure my own work. I know what it takes to keep a large book healthy from onboarding through every renewal, and I would like to bring that experience to your enterprise team.
body_paragraphs: At Brightspan I manage a book of 28 enterprise accounts worth $6.8M in ARR. In fiscal year 2025 the book delivered 94% gross revenue retention and 112% net revenue retention, against a company average of 104%. I designed the enterprise Gainsight health score with our operations team, combining product usage, support tickets, sponsor engagement, and NPS, and the at-risk playbooks built on it cut churn in my book by 130%. I also led renewal negotiations with customer procurement teams and converted 11 annual contracts to 3-year terms, which gave both sides more room to plan.

Your posting asks for comfort with SQL or BI tools, and that is one of my strongest areas. I write advanced SQL every day to build my own usage analyses and renewal forecasts, so I never wait on an analyst for the numbers behind a QBR. I run QBRs and executive business reviews with VP-level procurement and finance stakeholders, and I sourced $1.1M in expansion pipeline in Salesforce for our account executives, of which $640K closed. I also run a customer advisory board that brings feature requests straight to product.

Beyond the numbers, I am a passionate, results-driven team player who thrives in fast-paced environments. I believe in going above and beyond, thinking outside the box, and bringing my best self to work every single day. I am a strong communicator, a quick learner, and a natural problem solver who is always ready to wear many hats and drive impact across the organization. I truly believe that success is a journey and not a destination, and I am excited to keep growing on that journey with a team that shares my values. I am a people person who loves building relationships, and I am known for my can-do attitude, my strong work ethic, and my ability to hit the ground running in any situation. I am confident that my dedication and enthusiasm would make me a valuable addition to any customer success team, and I am eager to take on new challenges and continue learning every day.
closing_paragraph: I would love the opportunity to bring this experience to Vantorra and help your enterprise customers grow with you. Thank you for your time and consideration, and I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to the team and to the customers who rely on it every day. I am happy to share more about my approach to renewals, health scoring, and executive relationships whenever it suits your schedule.
tone_notes: Hand-written review probe with planted defects.
